newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan domestic WPI flat in second 10 days of May.
newsitem.headline: Japan domestic WPI flat in second 10 days of May.

text.p: Japan's domestic wholesale price index (WPI), a key component of the overall WPI, was unchanged in the second 10 days of May from the previous 10-day period, but was up two percent from the same period a year earlier, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) said on Wednesday.
The overall WPI fell 0.7 percent from the previous 10-day period but was up 2.6 percent from a year earlier.
The export and import indices -- the other overall components of WPI -- were down 3.9 percent and 3.4 percent, respectively, from the previous 10-day period.
Against the same 10-day period a year earlier, export prices were 2.7 percent higher, while import prices rose 9.5 percent.
